title: Pocketwire Pay in 4 Tier Ladder and Periodic Review
content:
Pocketwire Pay in 4 accounts are reviewed every 30 calendar days, and the review moves an account up or down the tier ladder. A tier is never changed between reviews or at the customer's request.

### The tier ladder

| Rank | Tier | Entry requirement: plans paid in full on time | Plans paid on time since the last move needed to move up | Missed installments over the previous 180 days at or above which the account drops | Tiers dropped | Review every (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | the account opening requirements; every account opens on this tier | 3 | 1 | 1 | 30 |
| 2 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 3 | 3 | 1 | 1 | 30 |
| 3 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 6 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 30 |
| 4 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 10 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 30 |
| 5 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 15 | 5 | 3 | 1 | 30 |
| 6 | Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 20 | 5 | 3 | 1 | 30 |

The figures in the last four columns are those of the tier the account is on at the review; the entry requirement is that of the tier it would move into.

### Review rules

**Moving up.** At a review, an account moves up one tier when both of the following hold:

1. its count of plans paid in full on time has reached the next tier's entry requirement; and
2. at least as many plans as its tier requires for a move up have been paid on time since the account's last move.

**Moving down.** At a review, an account drops the tier's number of tiers — one on every tier — when its missed installments are at or above the tier's threshold.

**Missed installments** are counted over the rolling 180 calendar days ending on the day the review is handled: the late fees charged on the account with a date in that window, together with the installments that went past their grace days on a tier that charges no late fee (Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite, whose late fee is USD 0.00).

**What the review records.** A tier change records the tier after the review, the date of the next review and the count of plans paid in full on time as counted at the review. The first review date is set when the account is opened.

### Truth table (hypothetical account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic; Select requires 6 plans)

| Plans paid on time in total | Paid on time since last move | Missed installments, previous 180 days | Result at the review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 3 | 0 | Moves up to Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select |
| 5 | 3 | 0 | Stays — below the Select entry requirement of 6 |
| 6 | 2 | 0 | Stays — fewer than 3 since the last move |
| 4 | 1 | 1 | Drops one tier to Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter — 1 missed installment is at the Classic threshold |

### Worked case (hypothetical account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select)

On a Select account the threshold is 2. One late fee charged 100 days before the review and one charged 200 days before it give 1 missed installment in the window, below 2, so the account does not drop. Had the second fee been charged 170 days before the review, the count would be 2, and the account would drop one tier to Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic.

### Basis Q&A

**Can a customer ask to be moved to a higher tier before the next review?**
No. A tier is never changed at the customer's request or between reviews.
